about: Fixes that parsing the PDF cannot get right. Each override must match exactly one parsed row, must state the value the parser produced (expect), and must give a reason; scripts/ccf/build-ccf.mjs refuses to run otherwise. They apply only to the PDF with the sha256 above. Source typos in the PDF itself are NOT overridden (see data/README.md).

match.area: 计算机体系结构/并行与分布计算/存储系统

overrides.reason: The abbreviation cell wraps as 'SIG-' / 'METRICS' (page 7), and the text layer cannot tell a wrap hyphen from a printed one. The venue's acronym is SIGMETRICS (the row's own dblp URL is conf/sigmetrics/). Contrast CCF-THPC, whose hyphen is part of the abbreviation and is kept.

match.area: 计算机图形学与多媒体

overrides.reason: The abbreviation cell wraps as 'INTER-' / 'SPEECH' (page 48); same situation as SIGMETRICS. The conference is INTERSPEECH (the row's own dblp URL is conf/interspeech/).

The 11-letter abbreviation is too long for its cell and Word broke it mid-word as 'JCOMPLEXI' / 'TY' without a hyphen (page 40); the text layer has no space there, but the line-join rule for abbreviations (space between wrapped lines, needed for 'HOT' / 'CHIPS') inserts one.
